results.title: Indagine urbinate: "Così l'algoritmo influenza il voto"
results.snippet: An article highlighting Fabio Giglietto's study on how Meta's content-recommendation algorithm reduced the visibility of mainstream Italian politicians by an average of 72% while leaving extremist accounts relatively unaffected. The piece outlines the significant concerns this raises for democracy and fair elections.

results.title: Algoritmi e democrazia, il caso Meta secondo lo studio di UniUrb
results.snippet: An in-depth piece detailing the local, national, and international political fallout of Professor Giglietto's research paper, 'A Pretty Blunt Approach.' The article notes that his findings prompted official inquiries within the European Parliament regarding how Meta's algorithms impact democratic processes.

results.title: Report - Puntata del 12/04/2026
results.snippet: An investigative journalism segment on Rai 3's program 'Report' that focused on the relationship between digital platforms and democracy. The broadcast extensively featured and discussed Fabio Giglietto's scientific research tracking over 2.5 million Facebook posts to show how algorithmic policies impacted political content distribution.
